spec.title: Digital Clock with Attractive UI
spec.summary: A responsive, real‑time digital clock featuring smooth animated transitions, customizable light/dark themes, and accessible design. The project delivers a modern, production‑ready UI with no backend, fully implemented using vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

files.name: index.html
files.purpose: Defines full page structure with header, main, clock container, responsive layout, and script references. Includes meta tags, title, and accessible ARIA attributes.

files.name: style.css
files.purpose: Implements responsive design, centralizes clock container, defines color scheme, animations for digit transitions, and accessibility styles ensuring legible text for all users.
